flow: Menu retains prior practice 2 stars / 3 warm crystals and directs the next letter to Cloudstep Mountain.
Three-card journey map shows forest/lake received and mountain available; desert and snow remain unavailable.
Enter mountain at the trailhead. Walk on the broad path to the lesson instruction point.
F reads the visual pattern; world text and HUD show echo leaf, echo sun, player bell.
E at the command point sends the echo to its actual bell pad. Walk separately to the player bell row.
Both echo notes become checked in the HUD; echo remains at its pad while the game waits for player bell.
F at the wrong leaf bell reports the required bell symbol and retains the two checked echo notes.
Walk to the bell symbol and press F. The first relay completes, saved confirmation appears and optional flag path opens.
E recalls the companion. Continuously walk the complete broad ascent without using the optional wind path or reloading to a checkpoint.
F reads the second pattern at the mountain pass: echo bell, player leaf, echo sun. E dispatches the echo on its independent route while the player starts up the main approach.
The echo reaches its independent pad and rings bell; the HUD checks that note and waits for player leaf. Walk to the actual leaf bell and press F.

The echo supplies the last sun note. The scene reports the second phrase saved, marks the station complete and visibly removes the pass gate. E recalls the companion and the player walks through the opening.
Walk past the former gate position to the goat's two-bell home and press F in range. The HUD and notice confirm Lanzjiao received the letter and a new reply is available.
Escape opens the mountain pause overlay; a second Escape returns to the map, which now shows the mountain reply and revisit button.
Open the reply album: the mountain reply is unlocked while desert, snow and ending remain locked. Read both mountain pages with Right, use R to return to page one and Escape to close.

Walk from the recovered checkpoint to Lanzjiao and press F; this now produces revisit chat while the delivered HUD state stays unchanged.
Escape opens the mountain-specific pause overlay; Return resumes the same scene. Begin walking back toward the optional route.
Walk continuously back from Lanzjiao through the open pass and down the main approach, then through the upper optional flag route to the green circular refuge.

The postcard icon and F prompt are readable at the refuge. F collects it, changes its world label to both spaces reserved and displays its companion-themed message; the delivered main quest remains unchanged.

Leave the refuge and stand on the lower wind path. Yellow flags and the warning hint appear. Without further movement input, the next windy state shows the cat returned to the already visited postcard flag, with the safe-return notice; the main delivery and postcard label remain intact. Intermediate displacement was not recorded frame by frame.

In the following screenshot the flags remain in the windy state and the cat stays on the green refuge. DOM data-game-ready is true and captured warn/error logs are empty. Pause the scene at this safe point.
